```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-identity
#| fig-cap: "Identity generation latency"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

cats = ['N=1', 'N=2', 'N=3', 'N=19']
x = np.arange(len(cats))
w = 0.25

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))

# N=1: CoordSpace (dense native inline, 0.39 ns)
ax.bar(x[0], 0.39, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')

# N=2: CoordSpace2 (dense heap) + CoordSpaceN2 (tree) + HashMap
ax.bar(x[1] - w, 0.39, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x[1], 0.90, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.bar(x[1] + w, 91, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

# N=3: CoordSpaceM3 (VM dense) + CoordSpaceN3 (tree) + HashMap
ax.bar(x[2] - w, 0.39, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='xxx')
ax.bar(x[2], 2.69, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.bar(x[2] + w, 120, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

# N=19: CoordSpaceN19 (tree) + SHA-256
ax.bar(x[3] - w / 2, 58.6, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.bar(x[3] + w / 2, 227, w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(cats, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('Latency per lookup (ns)')
ax.set_yscale('log')

# Label each bar with its absolute value
vals_list = [0.39, 0.39, 0.90, 91, 0.39, 2.69, 120, 58.6, 227]
for bar, val in zip(ax.patches, vals_list):
    label = f'{val*1000:.0f} ps' if val < 1 else f'{val:.1f} ns'
    offset = 1.4 if val < 1 else 1.15
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() * offset,
            label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7)

# Custom legend with proxy artists
legend_patches = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', hatch='///', label='CoordSpace / CoordSpace2 (heap dense)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', hatch='xxx', label='CoordSpaceM (VM dense)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', hatch='...', label='CoordSpaceN (tree)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', label='HashMap'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', label='SHA-256'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, fontsize=6.5, loc='upper left')

# Annotations comparing dense/tree vs HashMap and SHA-256
ax.annotate('91x vs HashMap', xy=(1.0, 5), fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white',
                      edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8))
ax.annotate('308x vs HashMap', xy=(2.0, 5), fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white',
                      edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8))
ax.annotate('3.9x vs SHA-256', xy=(3.0, 115), fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white',
                      edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8))

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
